description: Calling `thread/guardianReview` subscribes the connection to the thread. The subscription remains after the review completes, keeping the thread loaded until the client calls `thread/unsubscribe` or disconnects. Sequential calls on the same loaded thread can reuse Guardian history across direct reviews and live approvals. The reviewer keeps a separate conversation from the actor and follows the parent thread's normal persistence settings. A retry evaluates the final call again under the current policy.
title: ThreadGuardianReviewParams
